tiers.autopilot: reversible by a superseding commit or artifact: worker spawns, branch writes inside a write_set, artifact creation, fetch-to-disk, telemetry
tiers.gate: novel or cross-boundary: merges to main, contract amendments, superseding ADRs, checklist changes, mode-vector changes mid-mission, any deviation resolution
tiers.hard_deny: human-only verbs, no agent exception: credentials and secrets, spend and purchases, tags and releases and deploys, permanent deletion, external publication, hardware and account settings

rule: classify by reversibility first; when a verb fits two tiers, the stricter tier holds; hard_deny verbs are announced and queued for the human, never simulated
